name: JsMin
description: Automatically minify JS files on save.

children.title: Run on Save
children.description: Process the saved local JavaScript file using these output settings. Manual commands still work when No. Default: Yes. Automatic uses the previous preference, or the stated default, without saving it to this project.

children.title: Generate Source Map
children.description: Generate a .map file alongside the compiled output. Default: Yes. Automatic uses the previous preference, or the stated default, without saving it to this project.

children.title: Output Format
children.description: Compact removes formatting; Beautified adds line breaks and indentation. Compression is on by default; mangling is separate under Advanced. Default: Compact. Automatic uses the previous preference, or the stated default, without saving it to this project.

children.title: Output Suffix
children.description: Replace the source .js extension with this suffix, e.g. main.js → main.compiled.js using .compiled.js. Default: .min.js. Must end in .js and cannot be .js alone. Beautify Now still edits the source.

children.title: Keep Comments
children.description: Preserve comments in compiled output. Compression may discard comments attached to removed code. Default: No. Automatic uses the previous preference, or the stated default, without saving it to this project.

children.title: Compression
children.description: Enable UglifyJS optimisations. Turn off to retain code structure; mangling is controlled separately.

children.title: Mangle Names
children.description: Shorten eligible variable and parameter names. Separate from compression and output formatting. Default: Yes; saved preferences are preserved. Automatic uses the previous preference, or the stated default, without saving it to this project.

children.title: Preserve Function Names
children.description: Protect function names during compression and mangling. Enable for code relying on Function.name or clearer stack traces. Default: No, matching earlier releases; No does not force names to change.

children.title: Indent Size
children.description: Spaces per indentation level for beautified output, including Beautify Now.

children.title: Comments to Keep
children.description: Only used when Keep Comments is Yes. License keeps @license, @preserve and comments starting with !. Default: All. Automatic uses the previous preference, or the stated default, without saving it to this project.

children.title: Wrap Module
children.description: Optional module name for --wrap. Exposes exports and global inside a wrapper. Leave empty for unchanged behaviour; this is not a bundler.

children.title: Mangle Properties
children.description: Warning: can break public APIs, JSON keys and properties shared across files. Only enable for self-contained code; no shared name cache is used.

children.title: Property Name Pattern
children.description: Optional JavaScript regular expression body, e.g. ^_ to target private-style names. Empty targets all eligible properties. Used only when property mangling is enabled.

children.title: Reserved Properties
children.description: Comma-separated property names to leave unchanged, e.g. publicMethod, apiVersion.

children.title: Keep Quoted Properties
children.description: Exclude quoted property names from property mangling. Only applies when Mangle Properties is Yes.

children.title: UglifyJS Executable
children.description: Select a detected installation or enter a custom executable path. Paths containing spaces are supported.

children.title: Check UglifyJS Installation
children.description: Check the selected executable and display its version and installation status.
